{{Quote|Don't get me wrong. I'm not about to sit here blowing sand up your nose and tell you it's spice. That's not the way I work. I mean, I'm Kodo Arr, best smuggler in the galaxy, and there were times when I thought, "Kodo, there's no way you're making it off this pile of rock. You're gonna die here just like every other bantha-brain who thought he could come in, trick the Hutts, and come out ahead.|Kodo Arr, on smuggling on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="Smuggler's Trade">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040219smuggler|text=Smuggler's Trade|int=Smuggler's Trade}}</ref>}}
'''Kodo Arr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who made a living as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He honed his smuggling skills by taking jobs transporting loads on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and he later became a resident of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. Arr proclaimed himself to be the "best smuggler" in the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and he regaled the patrons of Tolea Biqua's [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] with stories of his exploits on Nar Shaddaa.
